main.description: An H3/region distribution of fused valuations (median + quartiles). AGGREGATE-ONLY: names no parcel, so it is publishable even where per-parcel valuation is barred by law or ToS. rkey = region|h3.

region.description: Region label (country / admin area / postcode district).

h3.description: H3 cell index of the region.

medianUsd.description: Median valuation across the region, USD decimal string.

nComps.description: Number of comps in the aggregate.
